guard >= baseline on every model/condition: True
limitations: Multi-model axis is replication: each model's baseline-vs-guard comparison is paired; no formal between-model hypothesis test (3 models only).
Transient faults are deterministic injections, not observed production failures; the budget conditions are controlled stress conditions (clean+1 / clean+4).
One calibration run per task per model anchors the budget; repeat seeds vary the fault surface, not model sampling (temperature 0 where the provider supports it).

Cheap and strong tiers are both Qwen-family models served by Alibaba Model Studio; the measured fault-free placement does not show the expensive flagship outperforming the mid-tier model on this tool-task set (see capability_placement).

Live-mutable ground truth: the HN top-story author's karma and current weather can change between task construction and a run; a few guard failures are ground-truth drift or answer formatting (failure_mode/answer in the records), not middleware failures.

When the artifact is finalised from a checkpoint (no re-run), task definitions are rebuilt after the run; per-cell success flags were computed at run time with the then-fresh ground truth, so drifting values in the metadata may differ slightly.
Prices are the published list prices at run time and are used only for the cost estimate.
Free public APIs are not production grade; API drift can affect reruns.
